provenance.scope: Selected actual result and integrity references; not a full portable bundle.
provenance.raw_evidence_location: Separate local automation-phase2 output; stores/reports/bundles/request logs are preserved outside Git.

contracts.name: tokenize-chat
contracts.claim: messages input; add_generation_prompt=true, add_special_tokens=false; tokens/count/max_model_len and optional token_strs; no engine inference

contracts.name: template-override-rejection
contracts.claim: non-null request.chat_template or chat_template_kwargs.chat_template rejected when trust flag false

contracts.name: chat-consumed-tokens
contracts.claim: rendered engine_input goes to engine_client.generate; return_token_ids request returns final RequestOutput.prompt_token_ids at top level

contracts.name: token-length-preconsumption-rejection
contracts.claim: max_input_tokens=context minus requested output; too many tokens raises input_tokens VLLMValidationError during renderer before generate; bounded CPU text scope only

contracts.name: tokenize-chat-context-is-not-enforced
contracts.claim: TokenizeChatRequest supplies a non-null TokenizeParams(max_total_tokens=None,max_output_tokens=0). Renderer inserts model-context defaults only if params is None. max_input_tokens therefore remains None; encoding uses truncation=false and text/token length checks return without a context constraint. This source inference is not a runtime measurement; bounded executor limits remain required.

extraction.method: read-only docker cp from the already running owned case2 engine; no start, stop, exec, or delete
extraction.other_files: Previously extracted same-pinned-image entrypoints and renderers under ../image-source

chain.claim: _token_len_check raises VLLMValidationError before returning engine input, with parameter=input_tokens and value=the captured token count.
__init__ stores parameter/value. __str__ appends parameter first and value second, producing exactly a parenthesized comma-space-separated suffix when both are present.
The app registers the VLLMError handler.
A validation error is dispatched to the generic exception handler, then create_error_response(exc) and JSONResponse with the resulting code.
VLLMValidationError selects BadRequestError, HTTP 400 and param=exc.parameter. The message is str(exc), then sanitize_message, with numeric code serialization.
Address, traceback and filesystem-path redaction does not remove the parameter=input_tokens/value decimal suffix.
Rendering/preprocessing occurs before engine_client.generate; renderer errors propagate through the registered exception handler.

supported_signature.message_rule: Existing exact source-derived context/output/captured-input/total message followed by exactly ' (parameter=input_tokens, value={captured_input_tokens})'.

limitations: This is static source inspection with byte hashes, not a new engine execution or a verdict.
Existing attempt01/attempt02 UNKNOWN evidence is preserved; the source review does not amend any EVD or RES.
A recognized error signature is limited to the exact reviewed image/version and bounded text-input profile; it does not authenticate arbitrary servers or source commits.
